scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:fixtures && npm run check:rules && npm run check:accept && npm run check:dts && npm run check:gates && npm test
scripts.check:accept: npm run accept && node scripts/accept.mjs --fixtures fixtures/accept
scripts.lint:fixtures: node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs fixtures/rules/boundary && node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs fixtures/rules/effects
scripts.check:dts: test -z "$(find src -name '*.d.ts')" || (echo 'src holds compiled modules only; an ambient declaration belongs in a *.typetest.ts' && exit 1)
